item.title: Capitals recall goaltender Garin Bjorklund from Hershey Bears, return Clay Stevenson to AHL

item.title: Tom Wilson not named in anonymous ‘most punchable’ NHL player poll after previously threatening to fight someone who listed him
item.description: Tom Wilson will no longer have any anonymous targets to hunt down after The Athletic published the results of their latest anonymous player poll. Wilson, who one anonymous respondent listed as having the “most punchable face” in the league during the 2023-24 season, did not appear when players were asked the same question this year.
